name: every collapsible section EXPANDED (six of the seven ship collapsed and .section-content is max-height:0 + overflow:hidden, so 23 of the 27 knob captions never lay out at their real size in the default state). FIRST, because the states are CUMULATIVE and the FX-tab click below hides the whole instrument panel.

TUNING tab (mounts the shared scala-tuning-engine panel into #tuning-container and reveals its 37 keyed captions — initTuningPanel() injects the panel LAZILY on first activation, so without this state every module caption is absent from the DOM and unmeasurable in every language). AFTER the expand-all eval, which needs the instrument panel active, and BEFORE the FX tab, which is documented LAST.
settings popover OPEN (reveals label.language, which is display:none until the gear is pressed)

FX tab (reveals label.fx.title and label.fx.body — .tab-panel is display:none until its tab is active). LAST, because clicking it makes #tab-instrument display:none and every label inside it unmeasurable.
